## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit (`feat(scope): …`, `fix: …`, `feat!: …` if breaking)
- [ ] Wiki updated (`wiki/` pages + `wiki/log.md`) if behaviour or decisions changed
- [ ] No API keys, personal data or local paths in code, fixtures or docs
